findings.description: get_relations called with 'Impersonated celebrity', a type/category rather than an entity or variable; instructions state the argument 'should always be an entity or a variable (e.g., #0) and not anything else'. Environment returned an execution error.
findings.notes: Agent recognized the mistake and adapted afterwards.

findings.description: get_attributes(#0) used although instructions restrict it: 'Please only use it if the question seeks for a superlative accumulation (i.e., argmax or argmin)'. The question ('what famous people does comic ferrell do impressions of') seeks no superlative.
findings.notes: Returned attributes were indeed useless for 'famous'; agent then assumed all are famous.
